subject: Geopolitics
title: Cyber Espionage
description: Learn Cyber Espionage in one minute.

hook.text: Chinese hackers stole 22 million US security clearance records in 2015. Names, fingerprints, secrets — all gone.

buildup.text: Cyber espionage steals data without physical intrusion. A hacker in Beijing can access servers in Washington overnight.

discovery.text: Nations spy on each other constantly through cyberspace. The US, China, Russia, and Israel lead the game.

twist.text: The line between espionage and warfare blurs online. SolarWinds gave Russia access to US government networks for months.

climax.text: Cyber espionage is cheap, deniable, and scalable. It's the perfect tool for nations that want to spy without risk.

punchline.text: The best break-in leaves no footprints at all.

quiz.question: Why is cyber espionage attractive to nation-states?
options: It is legal under international law
It is cheap, deniable, and scalable
